preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 5, inclusive.
The number of points is between 1 and 500000, inclusive.
The integer c is greater than 0 and less than or equal to 10^9.
The coordinates of each point are within the range of -10^9 to 10^9, inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output consists of two integers representing the minimum number of checkpoints and the minimum number of moves.
The number of checkpoints must be less than or equal to the number of points.
The number of moves must be greater than or equal to 0.

invariants.description: The total number of points across all test cases does not exceed 5 * 10^5.
